findings.finding: Generic JCS number handling creates avoidable cross-language ambiguity for security payloads.
findings.resolution: V1 narrows canonical numbers to signed integers within ±(2^53-1) and rejects floats.

findings.finding: Android ECDSA commonly exposes DER while a portable wire contract needs one format.
findings.resolution: V1 freezes IEEE-P1363 R||S; DER conversion is platform-adapter-local and cannot export private keys.

findings.finding: A schema-valid ExecutionGrant could be mistaken for an authenticated grant.
findings.resolution: PROFILE explicitly requires authenticated container or trusted resolution; raw JSON is never authorization.

findings.finding: A Python fixture checker could be promoted to cross-language or hardware proof.
findings.resolution: Contract docs and checker emit explicit NOT_EXERCISED states for those lanes.

remaining_dissent: ES256 platform signing and DER/P1363 conversions are NOT_EXERCISED.
